question: Which deity groups are assigned to the right and left sides respectively?
premises: The group beginning with Vakratuṇḍa is placed on the right side.
The group beginning with Ucchiṣṭā is placed on the left side.
The particle tu marks a contrast between these two placements.
inference: Therefore, the deities beginning with Vakratuṇḍa belong on the right, while those beginning with Ucchiṣṭā belong on the left.
uncertainties: The specific deities included in each group are not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: The deities beginning with Vakratuṇḍa are placed on the right, while those beginning with Ucchiṣṭā are placed on the left.
